title: Aesop's Fables, Volume 11 (Fables 251-275) - Hercules and Minerva
summary:
Aesop's Fables, Volume 11 (Fables 251-275) by . Dating back to the 6th century BC, Aesop's Fables tell universal truths through the use of simple allegories that are easily understood. Though almost nothing is known of Aesop himself, and some scholars question whether he existed at all, these stories stand as timeless classics known in almost every culture in the world. This is volume 11 of 12.
